name: micromamba
description: Installs the micromamba executable and optionally initializes it for the remote user's shell.

version.description: micromamba release/build tag to install (e.g. '2.7.0-0'). Use 'latest' for the current release.

initShell.description: Shell to initialize with micromamba shell init. Use 'auto' to detect the remote user's login shell, or 'none' to skip initialization.
